name: Kryzalis Progranyh Sniv
source: A guy who has lost his memory wakes up in a mysterious superstructure that has survived the end of the world. Its inhabitants play mahjong with each other to save themselves from oblivion. There, he will search for his memories, the reasons for the death of the past world, and hope for the future.
translation: 一个失去记忆的人在一个在世界末日中幸存下来的神秘上层建筑中醒来。这里的居民互相打麻将，以拯救自己免遭遗忘。在那里，他将寻找自己的记忆，寻找过去世界死亡的原因，以及对未来的希望。
